name: Classify changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: release-pending
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips the classifier too — every downstream leg is gated on
    # release-pending and would skip anyway, so classifying would be
    # wasted work (and a skipped classifier with empty outputs would
    # wave every changes-keyed leg past its path gate).
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      core: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.core || steps.filter.outputs.core }}
      app: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.app || steps.filter.outputs.app }}
      docs: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.docs || steps.filter.outputs.docs }}
      shared: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.shared || steps.filter.outputs.shared }}
      # PR-only (issue #303): a trajectory-touching diff flips this on so
      # the perf-gate leg below runs the #262 DoD gate per-merge.
      perf: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.perf }}
      # PR-only (gh-1241 REG-1): a trajectory/session/usage-touching diff
      # runs the usage-fold suite per-merge.
      usagefold: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.usagefold }}
      # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set — live on
      # pull_request events AND on SM validation dispatches: the paths
      # step derives the validated diff from merge-base(origin/main, HEAD)
      # when no pull_request context exists (fail-safe — a classification
      # failure runs the leg, never skips it).
      exzone: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.exzone }}
      # Issue #1267 N2: the diff modified flutter_app/pubspec.lock — the
      # transitive-drift vector that kept linux/windows release builds red
      # for five nights (#1265). Same path-triggered model as exzone.
      locksmoke: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.locksmoke }}
      # PR-only (issue #551): test/integration/** changes run the no-key
      # mock-LLM integration legs per-PR instead of at tag time only.
      intmock: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.intmock }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # base...head diff for the classifier below
          # gh-1477: blobless — historical blobs are never read; git
          # lazy-fetches the rare blob a diff actually touches.
          filter: blob:none
      # Non-PR events (tags, schedule, dispatch): everything is
      # affected — the full gate always guards releases. Since gh-1537
      # there are NO main-push events at all; the SM validation dispatch
      # (workflow_dispatch on the rebased PR head) is the pre-merge gate
      # and lands in this arm, so every validation runs the whole-tree
      # gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd) — nothing was
      # ever main-only.
      - id: filter
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The
          # flutter-app-lock-smoke legs are the pre-merge net; PRs not
          # touching the lockfile never pay for them.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '^flutter_app/pubspec\.lock$'; then
            echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]; then
            # Dispatch done — the stages classifier below reads a
            # pull_request event's base/head only; on dispatches the group
            # outputs stay with the non-PR filter step (full gate).
            exit 0
          fi
          stages=$(scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run |
            sed -n 's/^Fast gate scope: .*stages://p')
          echo "gate stages:[$stages]"
          # Empty output can only mean detection failure: full gate.
          [ -z "$(echo $stages)" ] && stages="size analyze test-core coverage crap dup dupx flutter integration-mock"
          case " $stages " in *"flutter"*) echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          case " $stages " in *"test-core"*) echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          case " $stages " in *"analyze"*) echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          # Issue #551: test/integration changes select the mock-LLM leg.
          case " $stages " in *"integration-mock"*) echo "intmock=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          # All nine stages selected = a shared/unknown path changed:
          if [ -z "$(echo $stages)" ]; then
            # Empty output can only mean detection failure: full gate.
            stages="size analyze test-core coverage crap dup dupx flutter integration-mock"
          fi
          if [ "$(echo $stages | wc -w)" -eq 9 ]; then
            echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #303: the #262 DoD perf gate must red-block the MERGE for
          # trajectory regressions, not only the release — before #551 the
          #…

Now, why would `flutter build apk --debug --flavor store` fail? Since our diff is only the quarantine JSON, the failure is most likely either:

2. A broken main merged into the branch (the merge included commits like 6d7e0d268).

- uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The macOS Podfile bundles the LiteRT-LM companion dylibs via a
      # Runner script phase that fails on a fresh runner ("Could not find
      # macOS companion dylibs") — seed from the pinned upstream native
      # release, sha256-verified (same incantation as build-macos.yml).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz
            echo "c597554a7a5cdf099658227099a54ef4916c5802b9182757e656e1788f9426b6  /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz -C "$GEMMA_CACHE"
          fi
          ls -la "$GEMMA_CACHE"

      - name: flutter build macos (debug)
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cd flutter_app
          if ! flutter build macos --debug 2>&1 | tee /tmp/build-macos.log; then
            if grep -qiE 'cocoapods|pod install|pod repo|No podspec' /tmp/build-macos.log; then
              echo "::error::macOS build failed in the CocoaPods layer — likely spec drift. Fix: cd flutter_app/macos && pod install --repo-update, commit the regenerated Podfile.lock (the pods cache re-rolls weekly, see the cache step). Raw log above."
            fi
            exit 1
          fi

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # SEC-08 (#796): CI supply-chain gate. Runs on EVERY PR — no path gating,
  # a security gate you can dodge with a cunning diff is not a gate.
  supply-chain:
    name: Supply-chain gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset

name: Classify changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: release-pending
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips the classifier too — every downstream leg is gated on
    # release-pending and would skip anyway, so classifying would be
    # wasted work (and a skipped classifier with empty outputs would
    # wave every changes-keyed leg past its path gate).
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      core: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.core || steps.filter.outputs.core }}
      app: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.app || steps.filter.outputs.app }}
      docs: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.docs || steps.filter.outputs.docs }}
      shared: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.shared || steps.filter.outputs.shared }}
      # PR-only (issue #303): a trajectory-touching diff flips this on so
      # the perf-gate leg below runs the #262 DoD gate per-merge.
      perf: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.perf }}
      # PR-only (gh-1241 REG-1): a trajectory/session/usage-touching diff
      # runs the usage-fold suite per-merge.
      usagefold: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.usagefold }}
      # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set — live on
      # pull_request events AND on SM validation dispatches: the paths
      # step derives the validated diff from merge-base(origin/main, HEAD)
      # when no pull_request context exists (fail-safe — a classification
      # failure runs the leg, never skips it).
      exzone: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.exzone }}
      # Issue #1267 N2: the diff modified flutter_app/pubspec.lock — the
      # transitive-drift vector that kept linux/windows release builds red
      # for five nights (#1265). Same path-triggered model as exzone.
      locksmoke: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.locksmoke }}
      # PR-only (issue #551): test/integration/** changes run the no-key
      # mock-LLM integration legs per-PR instead of at tag time only.
      intmock: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.intmock }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # base...head diff for the classifier below
          # gh-1477: blobless — historical blobs are never read; git
          # lazy-fetches the rare blob a diff actually touches.
          filter: blob:none
      # Non-PR events (tags, schedule, dispatch): everything is
      # affected — the full gate always guards releases. Since gh-1537
      # there are NO main-push events at all; the SM validation dispatch
      # (workflow_dispatch on the rebased PR head) is the pre-merge gate
      # and lands in this arm, so every validation runs the whole-tree
      # gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd) — nothing was
      # ever main-only.
      - id: filter
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The
          # flutter-app-lock-smoke legs are the pre-merge net; PRs not
          # touching the lockfile never pay for them.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '^flutter_app/pubspec\.lock$'; then
            echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]; then
            # Dispatch done — the stages classifier below reads a
            # pull_request event's base/head only; on dispatches the group
            # outputs stay with the non-PR filter step (full gate).
            exit 0
          fi
          stages=$(scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run |
            sed -n 's/^Fast gate scope: .*stages://p')
          echo "gate stages:[$stages]"
          # Empty output can only mean detection failure: full gate.
          [ -z "$(echo $stages)" ] && stages="size analyze test-core coverage crap dup dupx flutter integration-mock"
          case " $stages " in *"flutter"*) echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          case " $stages " in *"test-core"*) echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          case " $stages " in *"analyze"*) echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          # Issue #551: test/integration changes select the mock-LLM leg.
          case " $stages " in *"integration-mock"*) echo "intmock=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac
          # All nine stages selected = a shared/unknown path changed:
          if [ -z "$(echo $stages)" ]; then
            # Empty output can only mean detection failure: full gate.
            stages="size analyze test-core coverage crap dup dupx flutter integration-mock"
          fi
          if [ "$(echo $stages | wc -w)" -eq 9 ]; then
            echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #303: the #262 DoD perf gate must red-block the MERGE for
          # trajectory regressions, not only the release — before #551 the
          #…

Root cause identified: **infrastructure flake** — the `flutter_gemma_litertlm` native-assets build hook tried downloading `litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz` from `github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/...` and got HTTP 500 (transient GitHub release-asset failure). The archive has a registered checksum, so it's expected to exist — this is a transient network/upstream failure, not a code issue in this PR.

The Quality gate failure is just the aggregate of the build-android red leg.

This is an external download flake — nothing in this PR's code causes it. The correct rework action: verify the URL is reachable now (transient), then re-trigger... but wait — rework says "Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup". We cannot re-run CI from here (maybe we can via github_rerun_workflow? Actually the instructions say "CI will re-run automatically after the push"). The owner directive noted in comments: "red yields the slot — after 3 reds on the same head, validation waits for a NEW head". This was "red 1/3".

Options:
1. Verify the release URL now works (curl it). If it does, the failure was transient. To get a new head, we could make an empty commit... but "Do NOT run git commit" — wait, that rule was from the merge-conflict instructions in the previous leg ("Do NOT run `git commit` or `git merge --abort` — the commit and push are handled automatically"). That's about the merge resolution specifically. Hmm, but generally in these rework jobs, the harness handles commit/push.

2. Check if the repo has a mitigation for this: maybe there's a vendored/cached copy of the litertlm libs, or a hook cache mechanism. Let me check how the repo handles flutter_gemma native assets — maybe there's a "Native-assets hook cache" step in CI (I saw "Native-assets hook cache" in the cube kernel leg). Let me look for how ci.yml handles build-android hook caching.

Also check whether the URL is currently healthy.

name: Classify changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: release-pending
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips the classifier too — every downstream leg is gated on
    # release-pending and would skip anyway, so classifying would be
    # wasted work (and a skipped classifier with empty outputs would
    # wave every changes-keyed leg past its path gate).
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      core: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.core || steps.filter.outputs.core }}
      app: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.app || steps.filter.outputs.app }}
      docs: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.docs || steps.filter.outputs.docs }}
      shared: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.shared || steps.filter.outputs.shared }}
      # PR-only (issue #303): a trajectory-touching diff flips this on so
      # the perf-gate leg below runs the #262 DoD gate per-merge.
      perf: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.perf }}
      # PR-only (gh-1241 REG-1): a trajectory/session/usage-touching diff
      # runs the usage-fold suite per-merge.
      usagefold: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.usagefold }}
      # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set — live on
      # pull_request events AND on SM validation dispatches: the paths
      # step derives the validated diff from merge-base(origin/main, HEAD)
      # when no pull_request context exists (fail-safe — a classification
      # failure runs the leg, never skips it).

          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged

The archive has a registered checksum, so it's expected to exist — this is a transient network/upstream failure, not a code issue in this PR.

The Quality gate failure is just the aggregate of the build-android red leg.

This is an external download flake — nothing in this PR's code causes it. The correct rework action: verify the URL is reachable now (transient), then re-trigger... but wait — rework says "Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup". We cannot re-run CI from here (maybe we can via github_rerun_workflow? Actually the instructions say "CI will re-run automatically after the push"). The owner directive noted in comments: "red yields the slot — after 3 reds on the same head, validation waits for a NEW head". This was "red 1/3".

Options:

      - run: dart pub get

      # brownout (504 bodies hashed as mismatches, 2026-09-21) can't
      # re-break every job that re-downloads.
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test cube backends (live kernel legs)

      # tails, env merge, timeout kill). The group is tagged `integration`

      - name: dart test secure key store (macOS Keychain live legs)

- uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The macOS Podfile bundles the LiteRT-LM companion dylibs via a
      # Runner script phase that fails on a fresh runner ("Could not find
      # macOS companion dylibs") — seed from the pinned upstream native
      # release, sha256-verified (same incantation as build-macos.yml).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz
            echo "c597554a7a5cdf099658227099a54ef4916c5802b9182757e656e1788f9426b6  /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz -C "$GEMMA_CACHE"
          fi
          ls -la "$GEMMA_CACHE"

      - name: flutter build macos (debug)
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cd flutter_app

- uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The macOS Podfile bundles the LiteRT-LM companion dylibs via a
      # Runner script phase that fails on a fresh runner ("Could not find
      # macOS companion dylibs") — seed from the pinned upstream native
      # release, sha256-verified (same incantation as build-macos.yml).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz
            echo "c597554a7a5cdf099658227099a54ef4916c5802b9182757e656e1788f9426b6  /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz -C "$GEMMA_CACHE"
          fi
          ls -la "$GEMMA_CACHE"

      - name: flutter build macos (debug)
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cd flutter_app
          if ! flutter build macos --debug 2>&1 | tee /tmp/build-macos.log; then
            if grep -qiE 'cocoapods|pod install|pod repo|No podspec' /tmp/build-macos.log; then
              echo "::error::macOS build failed in the CocoaPods layer — likely spec drift. Fix: cd flutter_app/macos && pod install --repo-update, commit the regenerated Podfile.lock (the pods cache re-rolls weekly, see the cache step). Raw log above."
            fi
            exit 1
          fi

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # SEC-08 (#796): CI supply-chain gate. Runs on EVERY PR — no path gating,
  # a security gate you can dodge with a cunning diff is not a gate.
  supply-chain:
    name: Supply-chain gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]

The archive has a registered checksum, so it's expected to exist — this is a transient network/upstream failure, not a code issue in this PR.

The Quality gate failure is just the aggregate of the build-android red leg.

This is an external download flake — nothing in this PR's code causes it. The correct rework action: verify the URL is reachable now (transient), then re-trigger... but wait — rework says "Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup". We cannot re-run CI from here (maybe we can via github_rerun_workflow? Actually the instructions say "CI will re-run automatically after the push"). The owner directive noted in comments: "red yields the slot — after 3 reds on the same head, validation waits for a NEW head". This was "red 1/3".

Options:

        with:

      - run: dart pub get

      # brownout (504 bodies hashed as mismatches, 2026-09-21) can't
      # re-break every job that re-downloads.
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test cube backends (live kernel legs)
        run: dart test test/cube/backends

      # gh-1059 AC4: the real-keychain runner guard — `security`

      # bounded-helper machinery (outcome classification incl. stderr
      # tails, env merge, timeout kill). The group is tagged `integration`

      - name: dart test secure key store (macOS Keychain live legs)

- uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The macOS Podfile bundles the LiteRT-LM companion dylibs via a
      # Runner script phase that fails on a fresh runner ("Could not find
      # macOS companion dylibs") — seed from the pinned upstream native
      # release, sha256-verified (same incantation as build-macos.yml).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz
            echo "c597554a7a5cdf099658227099a54ef4916c5802b9182757e656e1788f9426b6  /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz -C "$GEMMA_CACHE"
          fi
          ls -la "$GEMMA_CACHE"

- uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The macOS Podfile bundles the LiteRT-LM companion dylibs via a
      # Runner script phase that fails on a fresh runner ("Could not find
      # macOS companion dylibs") — seed from the pinned upstream native
      # release, sha256-verified (same incantation as build-macos.yml).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz
            echo "c597554a7a5cdf099658227099a54ef4916c5802b9182757e656e1788f9426b6  /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz -C "$GEMMA_CACHE"
          fi
          ls -la "$GEMMA_CACHE"

      - name: flutter build macos (debug)
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cd flutter_app
          if ! flutter build macos --debug 2>&1 | tee /tmp/build-macos.log; then
            if grep -qiE 'cocoapods|pod install|pod repo|No podspec' /tmp/build-macos.log; then
              echo "::error::macOS build failed in the CocoaPods layer — likely spec drift. Fix: cd flutter_app/macos && pod install --repo-update, commit the regenerated Podfile.lock (the pods cache re-rolls weekly, see the cache step). Raw log above."
            fi
            exit 1
          fi

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # SEC-08 (#796): CI supply-chain gate. Runs on EVERY PR — no path gating,
  # a security gate you can dodge with a cunning diff is not a gate.
  supply-chain:
    name: Supply-chain gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]

name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >

runs:

  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash

        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"

          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \

            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz

          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"
```

Root cause identified: **infrastructure flake** — the `flutter_gemma_litertlm` native-assets build hook tried downloading `litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz` from `github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/...` and got HTTP 500 (transient GitHub release-asset failure). The archive has a registered checksum, so it's expected to exist — this is a transient network/upstream failure, not a code issue in this PR.

The Quality gate failure is just the aggregate of the build-android red leg.

This is an external download flake — nothing in this PR's code causes it. The correct rework action: verify the URL is reachable now (transient), then re-trigger... but wait — rework says "Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup". We cannot re-run CI from here (maybe we can via github_rerun_workflow? Actually the instructions say "CI will re-run automatically after the push"). The owner directive noted in comments: "red yields the slot — after 3 reds on the same head, validation waits for a NEW head". This was "red 1/3".

Options:
1. Verify the release URL now works (curl it). If it does, the failure was transient. To get a new head, we could make an empty commit... but "Do NOT run git commit" — wait, that rule was from the merge-conflict instructions in the previous leg ("Do NOT run `git commit` or `git merge --abort` — the commit and push are handled automatically"). That's about the merge resolution specifically. Hmm, but generally in these rework jobs, the harness handles commit/push.

2. Check if the repo has a mitigation for this: maybe there's a vendored/cached copy of the litertlm libs, or a hook cache mechanism. Let me check how the repo handles flutter_gemma native assets — maybe there's a "Native-assets hook cache" step in CI (I saw "Native-assets hook cache" in the cube kernel leg). Let me look for how ci.yml handles build-android hook caching.

Also check whether the URL is currently healthy.

VERSION_CLEAN="${TAG#v}"
          echo "version=$VERSION_CLEAN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  build-android:
    name: Build Android AAB
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351): gradle AAB
    # + bundletool validate historically ~20m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at build time, so the placeholder must
      # exist BEFORE flutter pub get (issue #368: aot_android_asset_bundle
      # died on "No file or variants found for asset: .env"). Content mirrors
      # the ci.yml/build-macos.yml incantation — bare `touch` is not enough
      # on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors the iOS GoogleService-Info.plist step: the committed
      # google-services.json is a placeholder (the google-services Gradle
      # plugin hard-fails without the file); overwrite it from the secret
      # when available.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written (package: $(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json'))['client'][0]['client_info']['android_client_info']['package_name'])"))"
          else
            echo "⚠️ GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      - name: Validate Android secrets
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON secret is not set — the Play Developer API service-account JSON key is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          echo "All required Android secrets are present"

      - name: Setup Ruby
        # ubuntu-24.04 runner images ship no Ruby — `bundle: command not
        # found` exit 127 (issue #353). Same setup as store-metadata.yml.
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      # The lane wraps `flutter build appbundle --release`; the upload
      # keystore rides the ANDROID_* env vars (issue #289) and is decoded
      # by app/build.gradle.kts into the (gitignored) build dir — no
      # key.properties dance. ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING makes a
      # secret-less release build fail LOUDLY instead of debug-signing.
      - name: Build Android AAB
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: the AAB's versionName rides the derived tag version
          # (BUILD_NAME) — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns. BUILD_NUMBER stays the run number
          # (Play versionCode).
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        run: bundle exec fastlane android build_release

Root cause identified: **infrastructure flake** — the `flutter_gemma_litertlm` native-assets build hook tried downloading `litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz` from `github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/...` and got HTTP 500 (transient GitHub release-asset failure). The archive has a registered checksum, so it's expected to exist — this is a transient network/upstream failure, not a code issue in this PR.

The Quality gate failure is just the aggregate of the build-android red leg.

This is an external download flake — nothing in this PR's code causes it. The correct rework action: verify the URL is reachable now (transient), then re-trigger... but wait — rework says "Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup". We cannot re-run CI from here (maybe we can via github_rerun_workflow? Actually the instructions say "CI will re-run automatically after the push"). The owner directive noted in comments: "red yields the slot — after 3 reds on the same head, validation waits for a NEW head". This was "red 1/3".

Options:
1. Verify the release URL now works (curl it). If it does, the failure was transient. To get a new head, we could make an empty commit... but "Do NOT run git commit" — wait, that rule was from the merge-conflict instructions in the previous leg ("Do NOT run `git commit` or `git merge --abort` — the commit and push are handled automatically"). That's about the merge resolution specifically. Hmm, but generally in these rework jobs, the harness handles commit/push.

Let me check how the repo handles flutter_gemma native assets — maybe there's a "Native-assets hook cache" step in CI (I saw "Native-assets hook cache" in the cube kernel leg).         with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Content-addressed native-assets hook downloads (sqlite3 et al) are
      # hash-verified on reuse — cache them so a GitHub release-asset
      # brownout (504 bodies hashed as mismatches, 2026-09-21) can't
      # re-break every job that re-downloads.
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test cube backends (live kernel legs)
        run: dart test test/cube/backends

      # gh-1059 AC4: the real-keychain runner guard — `security`
      # add/find/delete against the runner's login keychain through the
      # bounded-helper machinery (outcome classification incl. stderr
      # tails, env merge, timeout kill). The group is tagged `integration`
      # (real side effects), so the Linux core shards and the pre-commit
      # gate skip it; this macOS leg is where it actually executes. Skips
      # with a named reason when no `security` binary / default keychain.
      - name: dart test secure key store (macOS Keychain live legs)

- uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The macOS Podfile bundles the LiteRT-LM companion dylibs via a
      # Runner script phase that fails on a fresh runner ("Could not find
      # macOS companion dylibs") — seed from the pinned upstream native
      # release, sha256-verified (same incantation as build-macos.yml).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else

  build-android:
    name: Build Android AAB
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351): gradle AAB
    # + bundletool validate historically ~20m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at build time, so the placeholder must
      # exist BEFORE flutter pub get (issue #368: aot_android_asset_bundle
      # died on "No file or variants found for asset: .env"). Content mirrors
      # the ci.yml/build-macos.yml incantation — bare `touch` is not enough
      # on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors the iOS GoogleService-Info.plist step: the committed
      # google-services.json is a placeholder (the google-services Gradle
      # plugin hard-fails without the file); overwrite it from the secret
      # when available.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written (package: $(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json'))['client'][0]['client_info']['android_client_info']['package_name'])"))"
          else
            echo "⚠️ GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      - name: Validate Android secrets
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON secret is not set — the Play Developer API service-account JSON key is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          echo "All required Android secrets are present"

      - name: Setup Ruby
        # ubuntu-24.04 runner images ship no Ruby — `bundle: command not
        # found` exit 127 (issue #353). Same setup as store-metadata.yml.
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      # The lane wraps `flutter build appbundle --release`; the upload
      # keystore rides the ANDROID_* env vars (issue #289) and is decoded
      # by app/build.gradle.kts into the (gitignored) build dir — no
      # key.properties dance. ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING makes a
      # secret-less release build fail LOUDLY instead of debug-signing.
      - name: Build Android AAB
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: the AAB's versionName rides the derived tag version
          # (BUILD_NAME) — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns. BUILD_NUMBER stays the run number
          # (Play versionCode).
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        run: bundle exec fastlane android build_release

Root cause identified: **infrastructure flake** — the `flutter_gemma_litertlm` native-assets build hook tried downloading `litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz` from `github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/...` and got HTTP 500 (transient GitHub release-asset failure). The archive has a registered checksum, so it's expected to exist — this is a transient network/upstream failure, not a code issue in this PR.

The Quality gate failure is just the aggregate of the build-android red leg.

This is an external download flake — nothing in this PR's code causes it. The correct rework action: verify the URL is reachable now (transient), then re-trigger... but wait — rework says "Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup". We cannot re-run CI from here (maybe we can via github_rerun_workflow? Actually the instructions say "CI will re-run automatically after the push"). The owner directive noted in comments: "red yields the slot — after 3 reds on the same head, validation waits for a NEW head". This was "red 1/3".

Options:
1. Verify the release URL now works (curl it). If it does, the failure was transient. To get a new head, we could make an empty commit... but "Do NOT run git commit" — wait, that rule was from the merge-conflict instructions in the previous leg ("Do NOT run `git commit` or `git merge --abort` — the commit and push are handled automatically"). That's about the merge resolution specifically. Hmm, but generally in these rework jobs, the harness handles commit/push.

2. Check if the repo has a mitigation for this: maybe there's a vendored/cached copy of the litertlm libs, or a hook cache mechanism. Let me check how the repo handles flutter_gemma native assets — maybe there's a "Native-assets hook cache" step in CI (I saw "Native-assets hook cache" in the cube kernel leg). Let me look for how ci.yml handles build-android hook caching.

Also check whether the URL is currently healthy.

        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Content-addressed native-assets hook downloads (sqlite3 et al) are
      # hash-verified on reuse — cache them so a GitHub release-asset
      # brownout (504 bodies hashed as mismatches, 2026-09-21) can't
      # re-break every job that re-downloads.
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test cube backends (live kernel legs)
        run: dart test test/cube/backends

      # gh-1059 AC4: the real-keychain runner guard — `security`
      # add/find/delete against the runner's login keychain through the
      # bounded-helper machinery (outcome classification incl. stderr
      # tails, env merge, timeout kill). The group is tagged `integration`
      # (real side effects), so the Linux core shards and the pre-commit
      # gate skip it; this macOS leg is where it actually executes. Skips
      # with a named reason when no `security` binary / default keychain.
      - name: dart test secure key store (macOS Keychain live legs)

So the repo has a "Native-assets hook cache" pattern for some jobs, and a macOS leg already seeds the flutter_gemma litertlm dylibs from the GitHub release with checksum verification (`Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs` at line 2496). The build-android job does NOT have either the hook cache or a gemma seed step — it downloads directly during the gradle build, which makes it vulnerable to transient HTTP 500s from the GitHub release asset CDN.

This is the "same pattern across codebase" check: the macOS leg (line 2496-2509) seeds `GEMMA_CACHE` with a checksum-verified download. The Android job could do the same: pre-seed the flutter_gemma native cache before `flutter build apk`.

- name: Deploy Play listing (metadata + images)
        if: inputs.android_content == 'all'
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          PLAY_TRACK: ${{ inputs.android_track }}
          PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA: 'true'
          PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES: 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play service account not configured — skipping the listing deploy."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Deploying the Play listing (texts + images)..."
          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

  build-android-apks:
    # Issue #622: the flavor matrix. The AAB job above stays the Play
    # pipeline (store, unchanged); this job builds BOTH release APKs from
    # ONE variable — FLAVOR drives both the gradle --flavor and the
    # FA_FLAVOR dart-define (contract: the pair must never drift). god
    # (applicationId dev.fa1.app.god) is sideload-only and NEVER reaches
    # Play (binding threat model): it ships as an APK attached to the
    # GitHub release. store keeps its AAB for Play and additionally gets
    # an APK for direct installs + the UT-CI-1 size-delta tracking.
    name: Build Android APK (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # Same placeholder-.env incantation as build-android (issue #368):
      # .env is a declared Flutter asset and newer flutter validates
      # assets at build time.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors build-android, gated to the store flavor: the secret file
      # carries ONLY the dev.fa1.app client, while the god applicationId is
      # dev.fa1.app.god — overwriting it would hard-fail the google-services
      # plugin ("No matching client found for package name
      # 'dev.fa1.app.god'"). god builds with the committed placeholder
      # google-services.json, which carries both clients.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAVOR" != "store" ]; then
            echo "$FLAVOR builds with the committed placeholder google-services.json — the secret file has no dev.fa1.app.god client"
          elif [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written"
          else
            echo "GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      # Same release keystore as the AAB job (contract: store and god sign
      # with the SAME release key — only the applicationId differs), same
      # strict-signing posture: no silent debug-signed APKs. No Play
      # service account here — god never touches Play.
      - name: Build flavor APK
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: stamp the APK version strings from the derived tag
          # version — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns.
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        # ONE variable ($FLAVOR, job-level env from the matrix) feeds BOTH
        # the gradle flavor and the FA_FLAVOR dart-define.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flutter build apk --release --flavor "$FLAVOR" --dart-define=FA_FLAVOR="$FLAVOR" \
            --build-name="$BUILD_NAME" --build-number="$BUILD_NUMBER"

      - name: Verify flavor APK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-$FLAVOR-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
            echo "::error::app-$FLAVOR-release.apk not found under flutter_app/build/app/outputs"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "APK built successfully: $(ls -la "$APK")"

      - name: Store APK size delta vs previous release (UT-CI-1)
        if: matrix.flavor == 'store'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

        run: |

            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \

            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json

          # version — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns.
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        # ONE variable ($FLAVOR, job-level env from the matrix) feeds BOTH
        # the gradle flavor and the FA_FLAVOR dart-define.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flutter build apk --release --flavor "$FLAVOR" --dart-define=FA_FLAVOR="$FLAVOR" \
            --build-name="$BUILD_NAME" --build-number="$BUILD_NUMBER"

      - name: Verify flavor APK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-$FLAVOR-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
            echo "::error::app-$FLAVOR-release.apk not found under flutter_app/build/app/outputs"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "APK built successfully: $(ls -la "$APK")"

      - name: Store APK size delta vs previous release (UT-CI-1)
        if: matrix.flavor == 'store'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

- uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The macOS Podfile bundles the LiteRT-LM companion dylibs via a
      # Runner script phase that fails on a fresh runner ("Could not find
      # macOS companion dylibs") — seed from the pinned upstream native
      # release, sha256-verified (same incantation as build-macos.yml).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz
            echo "c597554a7a5cdf099658227099a54ef4916c5802b9182757e656e1788f9426b6  /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz -C "$GEMMA_CACHE"
          fi
          ls -la "$GEMMA_CACHE"

      - name: flutter build macos (debug)
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cd flutter_app
          if ! flutter build macos --debug 2>&1 | tee /tmp/build-macos.log; then
            if grep -qiE 'cocoapods|pod install|pod repo|No podspec' /tmp/build-macos.log; then
              echo "::error::macOS build failed in the CocoaPods layer — likely spec drift. Fix: cd flutter_app/macos && pod install --repo-update, commit the regenerated Podfile.lock (the pods cache re-rolls weekly, see the cache step). Raw log above."
            fi
            exit 1
          fi

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # SEC-08 (#796): CI supply-chain gate. Runs on EVERY PR — no path gating,
  # a security gate you can dodge with a cunning diff is not a gate.
  supply-chain:
    name: Supply-chain gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset

- name: Deploy Play listing (metadata + images)
        if: inputs.android_content == 'all'
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}

  build-android-apks:
    # Issue #622: the flavor matrix. The AAB job above stays the Play
    # pipeline (store, unchanged); this job builds BOTH release APKs from
    # ONE variable — FLAVOR drives both the gradle --flavor and the
    # FA_FLAVOR dart-define (contract: the pair must never drift). god
    # (applicationId dev.fa1.app.god) is sideload-only and NEVER reaches
    # Play (binding threat model): it ships as an APK attached to the
    # GitHub release. store keeps its AAB for Play and additionally gets
    # an APK for direct installs + the UT-CI-1 size-delta tracking.
    name: Build Android APK (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # Same placeholder-.env incantation as build-android (issue #368):
      # .env is a declared Flutter asset and newer flutter validates
      # assets at build time.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors build-android, gated to the store flavor: the secret file
      # carries ONLY the dev.fa1.app client, while the god applicationId is
      # dev.fa1.app.god — overwriting it would hard-fail the google-services
      # plugin ("No matching client found for package name
      # 'dev.fa1.app.god'"). god builds with the committed placeholder
      # google-services.json, which carries both clients.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAVOR" != "store" ]; then
            echo "$FLAVOR builds with the committed placeholder google-services.json — the secret file has no dev.fa1.app.god client"
          elif [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written"
          else
            echo "GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      # Same release keystore as the AAB job (contract: store and god sign
      # with the SAME release key — only the applicationId differs), same
      # strict-signing posture: no silent debug-signed APKs. No Play
      # service account here — god never touches Play.
      - name: Build flavor APK
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: stamp the APK version strings from the derived tag
          # version — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns.
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        # ONE variable ($FLAVOR, job-level env from the matrix) feeds BOTH
        # the gradle flavor and the FA_FLAVOR dart-define.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flutter build apk --release --flavor "$FLAVOR" --dart-define=FA_FLAVOR="$FLAVOR" \
            --build-name="$BUILD_NAME" --build-number="$BUILD_NUMBER"

      - name: Verify flavor APK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-$FLAVOR-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
            echo "::error::app-$FLAVOR-release.apk not found under flutter_app/build/app/outputs"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "APK built successfully: $(ls -la "$APK")"

      - name: Store APK size delta vs previous release (UT-CI-1)
        if: matrix.flavor == 'store'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

- uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The macOS Podfile bundles the LiteRT-LM companion dylibs via a
      # Runner script phase that fails on a fresh runner ("Could not find
      # macOS companion dylibs") — seed from the pinned upstream native
      # release, sha256-verified (same incantation as build-macos.yml).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz
            echo "c597554a7a5cdf099658227099a54ef4916c5802b9182757e656e1788f9426b6  /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz -C "$GEMMA_CACHE"
          fi
          ls -la "$GEMMA_CACHE"

      - name: flutter build macos (debug)
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cd flutter_app
          if ! flutter build macos --debug 2>&1 | tee /tmp/build-macos.log; then
            if grep -qiE 'cocoapods|pod install|pod repo|No podspec' /tmp/build-macos.log; then
              echo "::error::macOS build failed in the CocoaPods layer — likely spec drift. Fix: cd flutter_app/macos && pod install --repo-update, commit the regenerated Podfile.lock (the pods cache re-rolls weekly, see the cache step). Raw log above."
            fi
            exit 1
          fi

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # SEC-08 (#796): CI supply-chain gate. Runs on EVERY PR — no path gating,
  # a security gate you can dodge with a cunning diff is not a gate.
  supply-chain:
    name: Supply-chain gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]

        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at build time, so the placeholder must
      # exist BEFORE flutter pub get (issue #368: aot_android_asset_bundle
      # died on "No file or variants found for asset: .env"). Content mirrors
      # the ci.yml/build-macos.yml incantation — bare `touch` is not enough
      # on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors the iOS GoogleService-Info.plist step: the committed
      # google-services.json is a placeholder (the google-services Gradle
      # plugin hard-fails without the file); overwrite it from the secret
      # when available.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written (package: $(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json'))['client'][0]['client_info']['android_client_info']['package_name'])"))"
          else
            echo "⚠️ GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      - name: Validate Android secrets
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON secret is not set — the Play Developer API service-account JSON key is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          echo "All required Android secrets are present"

      - name: Setup Ruby
        # ubuntu-24.04 runner images ship no Ruby — `bundle: command not
        # found` exit 127 (issue #353). Same setup as store-metadata.yml.
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      # The lane wraps `flutter build appbundle --release`; the upload
      # keystore rides the ANDROID_* env vars (issue #289) and is decoded
      # by app/build.gradle.kts into the (gitignored) build dir — no
      # key.properties dance. ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING makes a
      # secret-less release build fail LOUDLY instead of debug-signing.
      - name: Build Android AAB
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: the AAB's versionName rides the derived tag version
          # (BUILD_NAME) — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns. BUILD_NUMBER stays the run number
          # (Play versionCode).
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        run: bundle exec fastlane android build_release
