- name: Deploy Play listing (metadata + images)
        if: inputs.android_content == 'all'
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          PLAY_TRACK: ${{ inputs.android_track }}
          PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA: 'true'
          PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES: 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play service account not configured — skipping the listing deploy."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Deploying the Play listing (texts + images)..."
          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

  build-android-apks:
    # Issue #622: the flavor matrix. The AAB job above stays the Play
    # pipeline (store, unchanged); this job builds BOTH release APKs from
    # ONE variable — FLAVOR drives both the gradle --flavor and the
    # FA_FLAVOR dart-define (contract: the pair must never drift). god
    # (applicationId dev.fa1.app.god) is sideload-only and NEVER reaches
    # Play (binding threat model): it ships as an APK attached to the
    # GitHub release. store keeps its AAB for Play and additionally gets
    # an APK for direct installs + the UT-CI-1 size-delta tracking.
    name: Build Android APK (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # Same placeholder-.env incantation as build-android (issue #368):
      # .env is a declared Flutter asset and newer flutter validates
      # assets at build time.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors build-android, gated to the store flavor: the secret file
      # carries ONLY the dev.fa1.app client, while the god applicationId is
      # dev.fa1.app.god — overwriting it would hard-fail the google-services
      # plugin ("No matching client found for package name
      # 'dev.fa1.app.god'"). god builds with the committed placeholder
      # google-services.json, which carries both clients.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAVOR" != "store" ]; then
            echo "$FLAVOR builds with the committed placeholder google-services.json — the secret file has no dev.fa1.app.god client"
          elif [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written"
          else
            echo "GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      # Same release keystore as the AAB job (contract: store and god sign
      # with the SAME release key — only the applicationId differs), same
      # strict-signing posture: no silent debug-signed APKs. No Play
      # service account here — god never touches Play.
      - name: Build flavor APK
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: stamp the APK version strings from the derived tag
          # version — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns.
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        # ONE variable ($FLAVOR, job-level env from the matrix) feeds BOTH
        # the gradle flavor and the FA_FLAVOR dart-define.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flutter build apk --release --flavor "$FLAVOR" --dart-define=FA_FLAVOR="$FLAVOR" \
            --build-name="$BUILD_NAME" --build-number="$BUILD_NUMBER"

      - name: Verify flavor APK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-$FLAVOR-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
            echo "::error::app-$FLAVOR-release.apk not found under flutter_app/build/app/outputs"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "APK built successfully: $(ls -la "$APK")"

      - name: Store APK size delta vs previous release (UT-CI-1)
        if: matrix.flavor == 'store'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

blocks.text:
## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.
- `cd flutter_app && flutter test --exclude-tags integration` green
  (includes golden suite; integration-tagged `test/cli_visual` runs
  pre-merge in ci.yml's `pty-visual` leg — gh-1538 retired the nightly
  duplicate — and on demand).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80% (full ratchet in the pre-merge SM
  validation gate — every run that exists is a whole-tree
  `scripts/check_coverage.py 80` dispatch run; ci.yml has no
  `pull_request` trigger and no main runs since gh-1537, so the
  diff-coverage arm in `coverage-gate` is reserve for a future real PR
  trigger); jscpd duplication < 1%
  core `lib/`, < 3.7% `flutter_app/lib/` (ratchet — only tighten).
- Cross-module duplication (issue #487): clones spanning module roots
  (`lib`, `bin`, `flutter_app/lib`, `packages/*/lib`, `browser_ext/dart`)
  via `scripts/check_dup_cross_module.sh` — stage `dupx`, ONE jscpd
  invocation, marker-parity with the CI `guards` job (which also runs it
  for app-only PRs — cross-module clones are usually born app-side).
  Baseline 0.3013% of the combined ~283k lines, pinned 0.31 in
  `ci_fast_gate.sh` (ratchet — only tighten; the per-package gates above
  cannot see across module boundaries).
- CRAP ratchet (`crap4dart analyze`, tool pinned as
  `dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"` — gh-1106
  superseded the old 0.10 bound; gates/baselines need 0.11), one config
  per package, thresholds are the current per-package max — only down
  from here:
  - core (`crap4dart.yaml`, sources `[lib, bin]`): **12.0** (issue #1234:
    the named census offenders moved — CC-12 trio + readPasteboardImage
    16.32 split, the 0%-cov CC-3 quartet and the named CC-9 tier covered
    or split, `_listModels` covered — but the first whole-tree
    measurement showed the 8.0 repin unearned: 54 methods at 12.00
    (CC-3@0% tier + covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00. Threshold
    stays at the measured max; the tier is the next ladder card).
  - flutter_app (`flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`, sources `[lib]`,
    issue #433/#475): **30.0** — measured by the SAME pipeline the CI gate
    uses (the two `flutter-tests` shards emit `--coverage`; the
    `app-crap-gate` job merges the lcovs and runs the pinned analyzer —
    widget-test coverage differs from the core's dart lcov, E2).
  - The app ladder (follow-up cards, NOT this one): 2450 → 870 → 702 → 650
    → 380 → 272 → 210 (done: `JsAppEngine._faCall` 2450→6 via map
    dispatch, `patch` 94→19, `_tokenize` 70→18; issue #475:
    `wasm_shell_git.run` route-table + 51 golden tests, app `main()`
    boot-phase helpers, `wasm_shell` beasts `_grepBuiltin` 812→covered

{"content":"name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"
","path":".github/actions/flutter-gemma-android-seed/action.yml"}

- uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The macOS Podfile bundles the LiteRT-LM companion dylibs via a
      # Runner script phase that fails on a fresh runner ("Could not find
      # macOS companion dylibs") — seed from the pinned upstream native
      # release, sha256-verified (same incantation as build-macos.yml).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz
            echo "c597554a7a5cdf099658227099a54ef4916c5802b9182757e656e1788f9426b6  /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz -C "$GEMMA_CACHE"
          fi
          ls -la "$GEMMA_CACHE"

      - name: flutter build macos (debug)
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cd flutter_app
          if ! flutter build macos --debug 2>&1 | tee /tmp/build-macos.log; then
            if grep -qiE 'cocoapods|pod install|pod repo|No podspec' /tmp/build-macos.log; then
              echo "::error::macOS build failed in the CocoaPods layer — likely spec drift. Fix: cd flutter_app/macos && pod install --repo-update, commit the regenerated Podfile.lock (the pods cache re-rolls weekly, see the cache step). Raw log above."
            fi
            exit 1
          fi

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # SEC-08 (#796): CI supply-chain gate. Runs on EVERY PR — no path gating,
  # a security gate you can dodge with a cunning diff is not a gate.
  supply-chain:
    name: Supply-chain gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset

- name: Deploy Play listing (metadata + images)
        if: inputs.android_content == 'all'
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          PLAY_TRACK: ${{ inputs.android_track }}
          PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA: 'true'
          PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES: 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play service account not configured — skipping the listing deploy."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Deploying the Play listing (texts + images)..."
          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

  build-android-apks:
    # Issue #622: the flavor matrix. The AAB job above stays the Play
    # pipeline (store, unchanged); this job builds BOTH release APKs from
    # ONE variable — FLAVOR drives both the gradle --flavor and the
    # FA_FLAVOR dart-define (contract: the pair must never drift). god
    # (applicationId dev.fa1.app.god) is sideload-only and NEVER reaches
    # Play (binding threat model): it ships as an APK attached to the
    # GitHub release. store keeps its AAB for Play and additionally gets
    # an APK for direct installs + the UT-CI-1 size-delta tracking.
    name: Build Android APK (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # Same placeholder-.env incantation as build-android (issue #368):
      # .env is a declared Flutter asset and newer flutter validates
      # assets at build time.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors build-android, gated to the store flavor: the secret file
      # carries ONLY the dev.fa1.app client, while the god applicationId is
      # dev.fa1.app.god — overwriting it would hard-fail the google-services
      # plugin ("No matching client found for package name
      # 'dev.fa1.app.god'"). god builds with the committed placeholder
      # google-services.json, which carries both clients.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAVOR" != "store" ]; then
            echo "$FLAVOR builds with the committed placeholder google-services.json — the secret file has no dev.fa1.app.god client"
          elif [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written"
          else
            echo "GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      # Same release keystore as the AAB job (contract: store and god sign
      # with the SAME release key — only the applicationId differs), same
      # strict-signing posture: no silent debug-signed APKs. No Play
      # service account here — god never touches Play.
      - name: Build flavor APK
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: stamp the APK version strings from the derived tag
          # version — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns.
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        # ONE variable ($FLAVOR, job-level env from the matrix) feeds BOTH
        # the gradle flavor and the FA_FLAVOR dart-define.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flutter build apk --release --flavor "$FLAVOR" --dart-define=FA_FLAVOR="$FLAVOR" \
            --build-name="$BUILD_NAME" --build-number="$BUILD_NUMBER"

      - name: Verify flavor APK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-$FLAVOR-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
            echo "::error::app-$FLAVOR-release.apk not found under flutter_app/build/app/outputs"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "APK built successfully: $(ls -la "$APK")"

      - name: Store APK size delta vs previous release (UT-CI-1)
        if: matrix.flavor == 'store'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

blocks.text:
## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.
- `cd flutter_app && flutter test --exclude-tags integration` green
  (includes golden suite; integration-tagged `test/cli_visual` runs
  pre-merge in ci.yml's `pty-visual` leg — gh-1538 retired the nightly
  duplicate — and on demand).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80% (full ratchet in the pre-merge SM
  validation gate — every run that exists is a whole-tree
  `scripts/check_coverage.py 80` dispatch run; ci.yml has no
  `pull_request` trigger and no main runs since gh-1537, so the
  diff-coverage arm in `coverage-gate` is reserve for a future real PR
  trigger); jscpd duplication < 1%
  core `lib/`, < 3.7% `flutter_app/lib/` (ratchet — only tighten).
- Cross-module duplication (issue #487): clones spanning module roots
  (`lib`, `bin`, `flutter_app/lib`, `packages/*/lib`, `browser_ext/dart`)

description: >-

  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the

  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion

  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.

      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"

- uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The macOS Podfile bundles the LiteRT-LM companion dylibs via a
      # Runner script phase that fails on a fresh runner ("Could not find
      # macOS companion dylibs") — seed from the pinned upstream native
      # release, sha256-verified (same incantation as build-macos.yml).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz
            echo "c597554a7a5cdf099658227099a54ef4916c5802b9182757e656e1788f9426b6  /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz -C "$GEMMA_CACHE"
          fi
          ls -la "$GEMMA_CACHE"

      - name: flutter build macos (debug)
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cd flutter_app
          if ! flutter build macos --debug 2>&1 | tee /tmp/build-macos.log; then
            if grep -qiE 'cocoapods|pod install|pod repo|No podspec' /tmp/build-macos.log; then
              echo "::error::macOS build failed in the CocoaPods layer — likely spec drift. Fix: cd flutter_app/macos && pod install --repo-update, commit the regenerated Podfile.lock (the pods cache re-rolls weekly, see the cache step). Raw log above."
            fi
            exit 1
          fi

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # SEC-08 (#796): CI supply-chain gate. Runs on EVERY PR — no path gating,
  # a security gate you can dodge with a cunning diff is not a gate.
  supply-chain:
    name: Supply-chain gate

- name: Deploy Play listing (metadata + images)
        if: inputs.android_content == 'all'
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}

          PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA: 'true'
          PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES: 'true'

          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

  build-android-apks:
    # Issue #622: the flavor matrix. The AAB job above stays the Play
    # pipeline (store, unchanged); this job builds BOTH release APKs from
    # ONE variable — FLAVOR drives both the gradle --flavor and the
    # FA_FLAVOR dart-define (contract: the pair must never drift). god
    # (applicationId dev.fa1.app.god) is sideload-only and NEVER reaches
    # Play (binding threat model): it ships as an APK attached to the
    # GitHub release. store keeps its AAB for Play and additionally gets
    # an APK for direct installs + the UT-CI-1 size-delta tracking.
    name: Build Android APK (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # Same placeholder-.env incantation as build-android (issue #368):
      # .env is a declared Flutter asset and newer flutter validates
      # assets at build time.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors build-android, gated to the store flavor: the secret file
      # carries ONLY the dev.fa1.app client, while the god applicationId is
      # dev.fa1.app.god — overwriting it would hard-fail the google-services
      # plugin ("No matching client found for package name
      # 'dev.fa1.app.god'"). god builds with the committed placeholder
      # google-services.json, which carries both clients.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAVOR" != "store" ]; then
            echo "$FLAVOR builds with the committed placeholder google-services.json — the secret file has no dev.fa1.app.god client"
          elif [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written"
          else
            echo "GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      # Same release keystore as the AAB job (contract: store and god sign
      # with the SAME release key — only the applicationId differs), same
      # strict-signing posture: no silent debug-signed APKs. No Play
      # service account here — god never touches Play.
      - name: Build flavor APK
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: stamp the APK version strings from the derived tag
          # version — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns.
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        # ONE variable ($FLAVOR, job-level env from the matrix) feeds BOTH
        # the gradle flavor and the FA_FLAVOR dart-define.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flutter build apk --release --flavor "$FLAVOR" --dart-define=FA_FLAVOR="$FLAVOR" \
            --build-name="$BUILD_NAME" --build-number="$BUILD_NUMBER"

      - name: Verify flavor APK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-$FLAVOR-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
            echo "::error::app-$FLAVOR-release.apk not found under flutter_app/build/app/outputs"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "APK built successfully: $(ls -la "$APK")"

      - name: Store APK size delta vs previous release (UT-CI-1)
        if: matrix.flavor == 'store'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

blocks.text:
## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.
- `cd flutter_app && flutter test --exclude-tags integration` green
  (includes golden suite; integration-tagged `test/cli_visual` runs
  pre-merge in ci.yml's `pty-visual` leg — gh-1538 retired the nightly
  duplicate — and on demand).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80% (full ratchet in the pre-merge SM
  validation gate — every run that exists is a whole-tree
  `scripts/check_coverage.py 80` dispatch run; ci.yml has no
  `pull_request` trigger and no main runs since gh-1537, so the
  diff-coverage arm in `coverage-gate` is reserve for a future real PR
  trigger); jscpd duplication < 1%
  core `lib/`, < 3.7% `flutter_app/lib/` (ratchet — only tighten).
- Cross-module duplication (issue #487): clones spanning module roots
  (`lib`, `bin`, `flutter_app/lib`, `packages/*/lib`, `browser_ext/dart`)
  via `scripts/check_dup_cross_module.sh` — stage `dupx`, ONE jscpd
  invocation, marker-parity with the CI `guards` job (which also runs it
  for app-only PRs — cross-module clones are usually born app-side).
  Baseline 0.3013% of the combined ~283k lines, pinned 0.31 in
  `ci_fast_gate.sh` (ratchet — only tighten; the per-package gates above

{"content":"name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"
","path":".github/actions/flutter-gemma-android-seed/action.yml"}

The Quality gate failure is just the aggregate of the build-android red leg.

This is an external download flake — nothing in this PR's code causes it. - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"

            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz

      - name: flutter build macos (debug)

          set -o pipefail

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at build time, so the placeholder must
      # exist BEFORE flutter pub get (issue #368: aot_android_asset_bundle
      # died on "No file or variants found for asset: .env"). Content mirrors
      # the ci.yml/build-macos.yml incantation — bare `touch` is not enough
      # on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors the iOS GoogleService-Info.plist step: the committed
      # google-services.json is a placeholder (the google-services Gradle
      # plugin hard-fails without the file); overwrite it from the secret
      # when available.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written (package: $(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json'))['client'][0]['client_info']['android_client_info']['package_name'])"))"
          else
            echo "⚠️ GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      - name: Validate Android secrets
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON secret is not set — the Play Developer API service-account JSON key is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          echo "All required Android secrets are present"

      - name: Setup Ruby
        # ubuntu-24.04 runner images ship no Ruby — `bundle: command not
        # found` exit 127 (issue #353). Same setup as store-metadata.yml.
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)

      # key.properties dance. ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING makes a

          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}

          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'

- name: Deploy Play listing (metadata + images)
        if: inputs.android_content == 'all'
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          PLAY_TRACK: ${{ inputs.android_track }}
          PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA: 'true'
          PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES: 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play service account not configured — skipping the listing deploy."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Deploying the Play listing (texts + images)..."
          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

  build-android-apks:
    # Issue #622: the flavor matrix. The AAB job above stays the Play
    # pipeline (store, unchanged); this job builds BOTH release APKs from
    # ONE variable — FLAVOR drives both the gradle --flavor and the
    # FA_FLAVOR dart-define (contract: the pair must never drift). god
    # (applicationId dev.fa1.app.god) is sideload-only and NEVER reaches
    # Play (binding threat model): it ships as an APK attached to the
    # GitHub release. store keeps its AAB for Play and additionally gets
    # an APK for direct installs + the UT-CI-1 size-delta tracking.
    name: Build Android APK (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # Same placeholder-.env incantation as build-android (issue #368):
      # .env is a declared Flutter asset and newer flutter validates
      # assets at build time.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors build-android, gated to the store flavor: the secret file
      # carries ONLY the dev.fa1.app client, while the god applicationId is
      # dev.fa1.app.god — overwriting it would hard-fail the google-services
      # plugin ("No matching client found for package name
      # 'dev.fa1.app.god'"). god builds with the committed placeholder
      # google-services.json, which carries both clients.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAVOR" != "store" ]; then
            echo "$FLAVOR builds with the committed placeholder google-services.json — the secret file has no dev.fa1.app.god client"
          elif [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written"
          else
            echo "GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      # Same release keystore as the AAB job (contract: store and god sign
      # with the SAME release key — only the applicationId differs), same
      # strict-signing posture: no silent debug-signed APKs. No Play
      # service account here — god never touches Play.
      - name: Build flavor APK
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: stamp the APK version strings from the derived tag
          # version — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns.
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        # ONE variable ($FLAVOR, job-level env from the matrix) feeds BOTH
        # the gradle flavor and the FA_FLAVOR dart-define.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flutter build apk --release --flavor "$FLAVOR" --dart-define=FA_FLAVOR="$FLAVOR" \
            --build-name="$BUILD_NAME" --build-number="$BUILD_NUMBER"

      - name: Verify flavor APK

blocks.text:
## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.
- `cd flutter_app && flutter test --exclude-tags integration` green
  (includes golden suite; integration-tagged `test/cli_visual` runs
  pre-merge in ci.yml's `pty-visual` leg — gh-1538 retired the nightly
  duplicate — and on demand).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80% (full ratchet in the pre-merge SM
  validation gate — every run that exists is a whole-tree
  `scripts/check_coverage.py 80` dispatch run; ci.yml has no
  `pull_request` trigger and no main runs since gh-1537, so the
  diff-coverage arm in `coverage-gate` is reserve for a future real PR
  trigger); jscpd duplication < 1%
  core `lib/`, < 3.7% `flutter_app/lib/` (ratchet — only tighten).
- Cross-module duplication (issue #487): clones spanning module roots

{"content":"name: flutter-gemma-android-seed
description: >-
  Pre-seed the flutter_gemma LiteRT-LM Android native cache so the
  flutter_gemma_litertlm build hook never downloads
  litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz mid-build. gh-1468: one HTTP 500 from the
  github.com release-asset CDN during that download red'd the ci.yml
  build-android leg (and the aggregate Quality gate with it). The hook
  short-circuits the download entirely once libLiteRtLm.so and a matching
  .flutter_gemma_native_version marker exist in the cache — same
  hardening the macOS legs carry via "Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion
  dylibs". The version/checksum below MUST equal the hook's _litertlmBundle
  registration in the pinned flutter_gemma_litertlm (hook/build.dart);
  test/ci_gemma_android_seed_guard_test.dart AC3 cross-checks both sides.
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Seed flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/flutter_gemma/native"
        PLATFORM_DIR="$GEMMA_CACHE/android_arm64"
        MARKER="$GEMMA_CACHE/.flutter_gemma_native_version"
        # The hook's cache-dedup predicate: main lib present AND the
        # marker carries this bundle's exact version (its
        # _invalidateBundleCacheIfStale wipes owned files on a version
        # mismatch, so a stale seed would be deleted and re-downloaded
        # mid-build — the roulette this action exists to stop).
        if [ -f "$PLATFORM_DIR/libLiteRtLm.so" ] && \
           grep -q '"version":"0.17.1-a"\|"version": *"0.17.1-a"' "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs already cached ($PLATFORM_DIR)"
        else
          echo "seeding flutter_gemma Android LiteRT-LM libs from native-v0.17.1-a"
          mkdir -p "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
            -o /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.17.1-a/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz
          echo "745b89b606eb712a78f06aed41daca1370eae79b00e0a36054c8e775c0251768  /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-android_arm64.tar.gz -C "$PLATFORM_DIR"
          # Marker commit point: {version, owner} exactly as the hook's
          # _writeMarker emits it (owner = the hook's _packageName) so the
          # pre-seeded cache keeps a single CodeAsset registrant.
          printf '{"version":"0.17.1-a","owner":"flutter_gemma_litertlm"}\n' > "$MARKER"
        fi
        ls -la "$PLATFORM_DIR"
","path":".github/actions/flutter-gemma-android-seed/action.yml"}

- uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The macOS Podfile bundles the LiteRT-LM companion dylibs via a
      # Runner script phase that fails on a fresh runner ("Could not find
      # macOS companion dylibs") — seed from the pinned upstream native
      # release, sha256-verified (same incantation as build-macos.yml).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz
            echo "c597554a7a5cdf099658227099a54ef4916c5802b9182757e656e1788f9426b6  /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz -C "$GEMMA_CACHE"
          fi
          ls -la "$GEMMA_CACHE"

      - name: flutter build macos (debug)
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cd flutter_app
          if ! flutter build macos --debug 2>&1 | tee /tmp/build-macos.log; then
            if grep -qiE 'cocoapods|pod install|pod repo|No podspec' /tmp/build-macos.log; then
              echo "::error::macOS build failed in the CocoaPods layer — likely spec drift. Fix: cd flutter_app/macos && pod install --repo-update, commit the regenerated Podfile.lock (the pods cache re-rolls weekly, see the cache step). Raw log above."
            fi
            exit 1
          fi

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # SEC-08 (#796): CI supply-chain gate. Runs on EVERY PR — no path gating,
  # a security gate you can dodge with a cunning diff is not a gate.
  supply-chain:
    name: Supply-chain gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]

        run: |
          if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written (package: $(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json'))['client'][0]['client_info']['android_client_info']['package_name'])"))"

          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}

        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          PLAY_TRACK: ${{ inputs.android_track }}
          PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA: 'true'
          PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES: 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play service account not configured — skipping the listing deploy."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Deploying the Play listing (texts + images)..."
          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

  build-android-apks:
    # Issue #622: the flavor matrix. The AAB job above stays the Play
    # pipeline (store, unchanged); this job builds BOTH release APKs from
    # ONE variable — FLAVOR drives both the gradle --flavor and the
    # FA_FLAVOR dart-define (contract: the pair must never drift). god
    # (applicationId dev.fa1.app.god) is sideload-only and NEVER reaches
    # Play (binding threat model): it ships as an APK attached to the
    # GitHub release. store keeps its AAB for Play and additionally gets
    # an APK for direct installs + the UT-CI-1 size-delta tracking.
    name: Build Android APK (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # Same placeholder-.env incantation as build-android (issue #368):
      # .env is a declared Flutter asset and newer flutter validates
      # assets at build time.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors build-android, gated to the store flavor: the secret file
      # carries ONLY the dev.fa1.app client, while the god applicationId is
      # dev.fa1.app.god — overwriting it would hard-fail the google-services
      # plugin ("No matching client found for package name
      # 'dev.fa1.app.god'"). god builds with the committed placeholder
      # google-services.json, which carries both clients.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAVOR" != "store" ]; then
            echo "$FLAVOR builds with the committed placeholder google-services.json — the secret file has no dev.fa1.app.god client"
          elif [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written"
          else
            echo "GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      # Same release keystore as the AAB job (contract: store and god sign
      # with the SAME release key — only the applicationId differs), same
      # strict-signing posture: no silent debug-signed APKs. No Play
      # service account here — god never touches Play.
      - name: Build flavor APK
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          # gh-1522: stamp the APK version strings from the derived tag
          # version — the committed pubspec is the static 0.0.0-dev
          # placeholder and never churns.
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        # ONE variable ($FLAVOR, job-level env from the matrix) feeds BOTH
        # the gradle flavor and the FA_FLAVOR dart-define.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flutter build apk --release --flavor "$FLAVOR" --dart-define=FA_FLAVOR="$FLAVOR" \
            --build-name="$BUILD_NAME" --build-number="$BUILD_NUMBER"

      - name: Verify flavor APK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-$FLAVOR-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
            echo "::error::app-$FLAVOR-release.apk not found under flutter_app/build/app/outputs"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "APK built successfully: $(ls -la "$APK")"

      - name: Store APK size delta vs previous release (UT-CI-1)
        if: matrix.flavor == 'store'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

blocks.text:
## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.
  Flake intake consumes PR-dispatch runs only (gh-1537:
  `scripts/flake_watch.py` filters to `workflow_dispatch` events — the
  retired main trigger leaves SM validation dispatches and v* tag runs;
  a red tag run is a release-flow failure, triaged by daily-publish /
  ci-red-report, never quarantined as a flake). Dedup is per test name
  (the #1364 lesson): one test red across N runs files ONE issue.
- `cd flutter_app && flutter test --exclude-tags integration` green
  (includes golden suite; integration-tagged `test/cli_visual` runs
  pre-merge in ci.yml's `pty-visual` leg — gh-1538 retired the nightly
  duplicate — and on demand).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80% (full ratchet in the pre-merge SM
  validation gate — every run that exists is a whole-tree
  `scripts/check_coverage.py 80` dispatch run; ci.yml has no
  `pull_request` trigger and no main runs since gh-1537, so the
  diff-coverage arm in `coverage-gate` is reserve for a future real PR
  trigger); jscpd duplication < 1%
  core `lib/`, < 3.7% `flutter_app/lib/` (ratchet — only tighten).
- Cross-module duplication (issue #487): clones spanning module roots
